description_en: Devajyoti Bāhāḥ is a branch of Bu Bāhāḥ (LAL0440). It is located to the north of Bu Bāhāḥ and can be accessed via a narrow alley that leads from the monument's north-west corner. The main shrine building faces north and stands on a double plinth. It is attached to the rear boundary wall, which is decorated with a pair of pilaster columns on either side. The monument appears to have been constructed relatively recently and has an overhanging concrete roof with a bell-shaped pinnacle and astūpaabove it. The shrine is plastered in lime and has been painted white. A stone statue of Akṣobhya is enshrined in the sanctum. Small statues of Gaṇeśa and Mahākāla have been attached to the boundary wall, on the left and right-hand sides of the shrine respectively.The courtyard (6.7 m x 4.2 m) is also home to adharmadhātujinālayacaitya(180 cm high) and adharmadhātumaṇḍala(90 cm high), both of which stand in front of the main monument and are lined up in its axis. The courtyard is surrounded by residential buildings and has a colonnaded structure on the ground floor. Two bells hang from the stone pillars on the eastern and western sides of the courtyard.Thisbāhāḥwas established by Devajyoti Vajrācārya in 1889. After his death, his wives established aguṭhīfor the management of thebāhāḥin 1897. The Mūladuvā clan (a priest clan) of Bu Bāhāḥ performs the daily worship in this shrine. Aside from this, all other social and religious activities related to thisbāhāḥhave come to an end.
description_ne: यो बु बाहा: (LAL0440) को शाखा विहार हो । यसलाई विहार भनिएपनि यहाँ कुनै क्वा:पा:छेँ छैन । बु बाहा:को दिगीको पछाडिपट्टिको भित्तामा टाँस्सिने गरी सानो मन्दिर बनाइएको छ । मन्दिरको गर्भगृहमा उत्तराभिमुख गरी ढुंगाको अक्षोभ्यलाई क्वा:पा:द्य:को रूपमा स्थापना गरिएको छ । मन्दिरको पूर्वमा गणेश र पश्चिममा महाकालको सानो मूर्ति स्थापना गरिएको छ । बाहा: परिसरमा एउटा धर्मधातुजिनालय चैत्य र एउटा धर्मधातु मण्डल स्थापना गरिएको छ । बाहा:को पूर्व र पश्चिममा एक-एकवटा घण्टा स्थापना गरिएको छ । यो बाहा: नेसं १००९ कार्तिक कृष्ण ६ को दिनमा देवज्योति वज्राचार्यले स्थापना गरेका थिए । देवज्योति वज्राचार्यको निधन भएपछि नेसं १०१७ मा बाहा:मा विभिन्न धार्मिक कार्य गर्न उनको नाममा जग्गा गुठी राखिएको थियो । बु बाहा:को मूलदुवा समूहको एउटा वज्राचार्य परिवारबाट यो बाहा: सञ्चालन भइरहेको छ । हाल नित्यपूजा बाहेक अन्य पूजाहरू बन्द भइसकेका छन् ।
monument_assessment: Slightly damaged (minor damages such as minor cracks, plants, missing stones in plinths), Rebuilt

historical_events.event_description: Devajyoti Vajrācārya established thisbāhāḥas well as acaityaand adharmadhātu maṇḍala.
Mānakumārī and Thakũmatī endowed land to establish aguṭhīfor the management of the Bāhāḥ.
